summary: The patch prevents cancellation-only self-observation runs from filing issues while retaining reports for actual failure conclusions, and the regression coverage exercises the recorded cancelled run shape.

evidence: The job selector in ops/hosted-autonomy-observation.ts now prioritizes failure, timed_out, and startup_failure jobs and excludes cancelled from the fallback, so a cancellation-only run produces no issue.

The regression test in tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts reproduces run 40583137237 with maintenance cancelled, prepare skipped, and finalize successful, then asserts no log read, issue-body read, or issue filing.
A separate regression test confirms that a cancelled sibling does not mask an actual failure job, preserving genuine failure reporting.
